scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @survey-synth/domain build && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/contracts build && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/statistics build && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/synthesis-core build && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/test-support build
scripts.test:typescript: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/domain test && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/contracts test && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/synthesis-core test && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/sidecar test && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/desktop test && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.build:sidecar: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/sidecar build && node scripts/stage-sidecar.mjs
scripts.test:packaged-runtime: pnpm run build:sidecar && pnpm --filter @survey-synth/sidecar exec vitest run test/packaged-smoke.test.ts test/compiled-export-smoke.test.ts test/worker-smoke.test.ts && cargo test --test bridge_integration launches_staged_self_contained_sidecar_without_system_node -- --ignored
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:sidecar && pnpm exec vitest run tests/integration
